66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 description: Medved Cell has stopped moving in pieces. Sokol, Buran, and Kedr are operating together under full readiness. Tony wants the whole cell removed in one raid before they scatter again.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 note: Sokol is the commander. Buran is the shield. Kedr is the scout. Tony wants all three dead in the same raid.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 startedMessageT: This is not a hunt anymore. This is cleanup. Sokol, Buran, Kedr. Same raid. You leave one breathing, the cell grows back.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 successMessageT: Good. Commander is dead, shield is broken, scout is quiet. Medved Cell is not a cell anymore. Just bodies with bad patches.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 failMessageText: No. One of them is still breathing, and that means all of them are still a problem.
66a30f00d2999bc7b9bba930 acceptPlayerMes: Understood. I will finish Medved Cell.
66a30f02d2999bc7b9bba932: Eliminate Sokol in the same raid.
66a30f05d2999bc7b9bba935: Eliminate Buran in the same raid.
66a30f08d2999bc7b9bba938: Eliminate Kedr in the same raid.
